description: Retrieve the full transcript for a media file with speaker labels and timestamps. Works on processed media and also returns the partial, in-progress transcript while a meeting bot is still recording (LIVE_TRANSCRIPT state). To fetch only the new sentences added since your previous call during a live meeting, use get_live_meeting_transcript instead. Use update_transcript_speakers to rename speaker labels after reviewing. For subtitle-formatted output, use get_captions instead.

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the media file

name: get_transcript

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Get Transcript
